product_category: B2B Developer Security & Code Analysis SaaS
verified_capabilities: IDE extensions for VS Code, JetBrains, and Cursor offering real-time AI security remediation prompts
CI/CD automated pipeline integration (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bitbucket Pipelines) scanning pull requests in under 90 seconds
SAST vulnerability detection targeting OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25, and high-entropy API secret leaks
Auto-fix pull request generation with contextual security patches verified against language syntax trees (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java)
Compliance mapping report generator producing downloadable audit-ready SARIF and ISO 27001 / PCI-DSS compliance readiness checklists
On-premise / VPC air-gapped runner deployment option for regulated fintech and banking clients
Self-serve 14-day free trial with up to 5 repository scans without requiring credit card
unverified_prohibited_claims: 100% guarantee against all zero-day vulnerabilities or future security breaches
Instant replacement of human security audit teams or certified penetration testers
Legally binding automated certification of SOC 2 or HIPAA compliance
Unconditional zero-false-positive rate across any arbitrary legacy codebase

pricing_model.developer_tier: Free for public open-source repositories and up to 3 private repositories
pricing_model.team_tier: per contributing developer per month (billed annually) for up to 50 repos
pricing_model.enterprise_tier: Custom tier with dedicated VPC coordinator, SLA, and enterprise compliance reporting

primary_competitors: Snyk (High price barrier for mid-sized Vietnamese tech teams, USD-denominated enterprise contracts)
SonarQube (Strong on code quality, slower on AI-assisted vulnerability auto-remediation and secret scanning)
market_context.target_firmographic_profile: Mid-tier tech startups, outsourced software development houses (ODCs), and emerging fintechs with 10-150 developers in Vietnam and Singapore
